title: Elderly & Geriatric Assistance
detail: Assistance with daily living (ADLs), feeding, bathing, medication schedule, mobility, and compassionate companionship for senior citizens.

title: Post-Operative Recovery
detail: Post-discharge surgical care, knee/hip replacement rehab, incision monitoring, pain supervision, and safe mobility assistance.

title: Bedridden & Paralysis Patient Care
detail: Bed sore prevention (Q2H repositioning), diaper hygiene, sponge baths, back massage, catheter care, and transfer assistance.

title: Dementia & Alzheimer's Support
detail: Patience-centered memory care, gentle cognitive engagement, wander safety, evening sundowning comfort, and consistent emotional grounding.

title: Doctor Visit at Home (20 Mins)
detail: Certified general physicians and specialists arrive at your doorstep across Gurgaon equipped with portable diagnostics and emergency kits.

title: ICU & Critical Care Nursing
detail: GNM/B.Sc trained nurses for IV infusions, tracheostomy care, catheterization, Ryle's tube feeding, and post-ICU ventilator monitoring.

title: Home Physiotherapy & Rehab
detail: Doctor-prescribed physiotherapy sessions for stroke recovery, chronic joint/back pain, sports injuries, and neurological re-education.

title: Palliative & Oncology Support
detail: Compassionate end-of-life and cancer palliative care, pain relief assistance, oxygen management, and empathetic family support.

title: Stroke & Neuro Rehabilitation
detail: Post-stroke daily assisted mobility, passive range-of-motion exercises, swallowing precautions, and continuous doctor tele-monitoring.

title: Doorstep Blood Tests & ECG
detail: Phlebotomist arrives within 30 minutes for blood sample collection, digital 12-lead ECG, urine analysis, and rapid digital lab reports.
